briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P -0.1%), but three candidates — DK, KSS, and DHT — showed full multi-signal confirmation (MACD crossover, bullish RSI, price above SMA-20, volume surge), so we're filling our three open slots with high-conviction names rather than holding idle cash. No existing positions were touched since none hit stop-loss or profit-target levels.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of relying on just one indicator, momentum confirmation means checking that several signals — like a MACD crossover, healthy RSI level, price above its moving average, and a volume surge — all line up together before buying. This reduces the chance of chasing a false signal or random price spike, even when the overall market looks quiet or neutral.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指不單靠一個指標做決定,而是同時檢查多項訊號——例如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康區間、股價站上均線,以及成交量放大——都同步出現時才進場。這樣可以降低追逐假訊號或隨機價格波動的風險,即使大盤整體表現平淡也能找到真正強勢的個股。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with the S&P 500 down 0.1% and the NASDAQ down 0.4%. There was no single dominant macro catalyst driving the session, consistent with a neutral, wait-and-see tone across risk assets. Beneath the surface, however, select names in energy, retail, and shipping showed strong technical breakouts on above-average volume, suggesting selective institutional buying even as the broader market stayed flat.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡,標普500指數下跌0.1%,納斯達克指數下跌0.4%,市場缺乏明確的主導消息面因素,整體呈現觀望氣氛。不過在指數持平的表面下,部分能源、零售及航運類股在成交量放大的情況下出現技術面突破,顯示資金仍在個股層面進行精選布局。
